author: Portenko, 1935
summary: 국가생물종목록에 올라 있으나 남한에서 사진이나 표본으로 확인된 기록은 찾지 못한 새이다. 네팔과 인도 북부 등 히말라야 산지와 그에 잇닿은 중국 남부의 산지에 산다. 이 새의 옛 학명 Buteo burmanicus 는 지금은 대륙에서 번식해 우리나라에도 찾아오는 말똥가리 아종의 이름이어서, 두 새의 기록을 가릴 때 주의해야 한다.

points.en: dark, finely streaked head with a solid dark moustachial stripe
solid dark belly band of even width, darker than the paler upper breast
upperwing coverts with prominent pale rufous or whitish edges

points.ko: 날개 아랫면의 짙은 손목 얼룩과 좁고 어두운 뒷가장자리(어른새)
points.en: dark carpal patch and narrow dark trailing edge on the underwing (adult)

points.ko: 끝 쪽에 짙은 띠가 있는 가로줄 꼬리(어른새)
points.en: barred tail with a darker terminal or subterminal band (adult)

young: 어린새는 눈이 옅은 빛이고, 꼬리에 끝띠 없이 고른 가로줄이 있으며, 날개 아랫면 뒷가장자리가 어둡지 않다. 배띠가 가운데서 끊긴 개체가 많다.

similar.how: 깃이 매우 비슷하거나 같아 야외에서 가려낼 확실한 기준이 아직 없다. 다만 말똥가리에는 온몸이 짙은 갈색인 어두운형이 없다.
큰말똥가리는 더 크고 육중하며 부리가 굵고 날개가 더 길고, 부척의 3/4 넘게 깃으로 덮인다(히말라야말똥가리는 절반쯤).

art.subject: Himalayan Buzzard (Buteo refectus), adult of the common 'belted' type: head dark brown and finely streaked, with a creamy wash and a solid dark moustachial stripe; mantle and upperparts dark brown, the upperwing coverts with prominent pale rufous or whitish edges; upper breast paler brownish-white, below it a solid dark brown belly band of even width, the lower belly and vent whitish; thighs dark brown. Tail brown with fine dark bars and a darker subterminal band. Eye dark brown, the pupil hardly visible; cere yellow; bill dark grey with a black hooked tip; feet yellow.
art.pose: perched upright on a bare branch at a forest edge, head turned slightly towards the viewer
art.scene: edge of a Himalayan mountain forest of oaks and conifers above a grassy slope, clear autumn light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult 'belted' type, side view perched upright: dark finely streaked head with a solid dark moustachial stripe, dark eye, yellow cere, dark brown upperparts with prominent pale rufous edges to the upperwing coverts, paler brownish-white upper breast above a solid dark brown belly band, whitish lower belly, yellow feet, barred tail with a darker subterminal band

adult 'belted' type, in flight seen squarely from below: broad wings with a broad, blunt hand spread straight out from the shoulders, dark carpal patch on variably marked underwing coverts, dark-barred secondaries and inner primaries, faintly barred outer primaries, narrow dark trailing edge, dark belly band, fanned barred tail with a darker subterminal band
art.build: Medium-sized, compact buzzard of the Common Buzzard group, much like Eastern Buzzard (Buteo japonicus) in size and shape: rounded head, short neck, upright stance. Bill short, rather weak and hooked, with no fleshy gape. Legs short and yellow, the tarsus feathered for about half its length (hidden by the belly feathers when perched). Wings broad with a broad, blunt wingtip, shorter and broader than Steppe Buzzard's; tail fairly short and fan-shaped when spread.
art.basis: 형태: Ganpule 2023(Indian BIRDS 19(5): 131–147)과 말똥가리 무리의 일반 특징(노란 납막·발) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint a plain, unbarred white or orange tail — that is Long-legged Buzzard (Buteo rufinus).
Do not paint the breast and belly one even colour; the belly band is clearly darker than the paler upper breast.
Do not feather the legs down to the toes like Upland Buzzard (Buteo hemilasius); the tarsus is feathered only about half way.
Do not paint a deep, eagle-like bill or a pale eye on the adult.
art.notes: 여러 색 변이형이 있는 종(가로줄형·배띠형·온몸 짙은형). 히말라야에서 흔한 배띠형 어른새로 그림. 몸길이 수치는 확인한 자료에 없어 쓰지 않음
